title: Block coordinates of the tribes equivalence
statement: For natural numbers $w,s$, an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^{sw}$, and a block index $i\in\{0,\ldots,s-1\}$, the $i$th block of the image of $x$ under the block equivalence is the length-$w$ vector whose $j$th coordinate is the coordinate of $x$ indexed by the pair $(i,j)$, for every $j\in\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$.
